route: domestic exchange-listed public REIT research route; no product selected

scope_control.reason: This is a readiness audit only. A retained, pre-existing source probe is used solely to audit evidence fields; it neither selects the underlying product nor imports any prior return calculation.

overall_conclusion.statement: The route presently satisfies only a limited product-level source preflight. It does not satisfy the rigorous strategy-test readiness gate because investor-level total return, dated after-cost execution, eligibility, and point-in-time universe evidence are incomplete.

retained_nonselective_probe.role: Historical source-field probe only; not a product selection, recommendation, or performance input in this C20 artifact.
limitations: The retained market-data responses are retrospective public responses, not point-in-time investor records.
Hashes establish local file integrity only; they do not establish historical availability, adjustment convention, personal costs, eligibility, or execution.

current_rule_capture_manifest.role: Retained current SSE rule pages and rule bodies used only for C20 version and general-mechanics context.

r13_r10_v1_scope_correction.role: Corrects the audit provenance after the legacy R10 v1 checker was re-executed against C20 v2. It documents why the resulting sole URL-only assertion failure is not a current v2 source-control regression.

legacy_r10_v1_verifier_reexecution_trace.role: Retained legacy-v1 verifier output produced after C20 v2. It is a scope-mismatch trace only and must not be read as a current C20 v2 audit failure.

live_primary_rule_recheck.source: Shanghai Stock Exchange current public REIT business rule
live_primary_rule_recheck.finding: The current rule states that the SSE's 2021 public-infrastructure-REIT business rule was simultaneously repealed. Its investor and trading provisions describe generic participation, risk-disclosure and venue mechanics.
live_primary_rule_recheck.boundary: The rule-level route and risk-disclosure conditions do not demonstrate a particular person's broker permission, suitability, order acceptance, or settlement.

live_primary_rule_recheck.source: Shanghai Stock Exchange repealed 2021 public-infrastructure-REIT business-rule page
live_primary_rule_recheck.finding: The page marks the 2021 rule as repealed.

live_primary_rule_recheck.source: Shanghai Stock Exchange infrastructure public-REIT investor-education material
live_primary_rule_recheck.finding: It provides general venue mechanics for account use, order-size increments and minimum price variation.
live_primary_rule_recheck.boundary: General market mechanics do not prove a particular person's current broker access, suitability, order acceptance or settlement.

live_primary_rule_recheck.finding: The fund competitive-trading provision specifies an order quantity of 100 units or whole multiples, with an odd residual sellable in one order. Together with the current REIT rule's fund-trading reference, this is general lot-mechanics evidence.
live_primary_rule_recheck.boundary: This is not a product-specific broker order-acceptance or liquidity record.

source_control_amendment.reason: R10-SC-01 found that the four current-rule rechecks in v1 were URL-only. v2 retains the four public pages and two linked rule bodies in a separate immutable source batch and binds its manifest. The legacy R10 v1 checker was later re-executed against v2; R13 preserves and corrects that scope mismatch rather than treating its obsolete URL-only assertion as a new defect. This changes no route, product selection, universe, return test, result, eligibility inference or action boundary.

rule_and_product_history: Retained primary materials include a 2020 CSRC guideline announcement, a 2021 SSE infrastructure-REIT business rule, a 2021 listing announcement, and date-labelled product disclosures from 2024 through the 2025 annual-report disclosure published in 2026.
The retained 2021 venue rule is launch-era historical evidence only; the live 2025 rule recheck establishes that it is no longer the current rule.

daily_market_price.what_it_supports: A future, predeclared price-only diagnostic can locate complete-calendar-year boundaries for 2022 through 2025 and has more than a nominal five-year span.
what_it_does_not_support: A certified complete trading-calendar record or point-in-time availability history.
An adjusted-price, investor-total-return, NAV, tax, or execution ledger.
Bid/ask, depth, fill, partial-fill, no-fill, suspension, correction, or settlement evidence.

distribution_history.what_it_supports: Identification of disclosed cash-distribution events for a future ledger design.
what_it_does_not_support: Investor-specific entitlement, cash-credit date, tax, reinvestment, transfer, or settlement records.
A conclusion that cash distributions equal total return or NAV return.

nav_endpoint.interpretation: The queried SSE historical-NAV endpoint returned no rows in the retained capture. This is an endpoint observation only; it neither proves that historical NAV is unavailable elsewhere nor substitutes for a total-return ledger.

gate_matrix.evidence: Launch-era CSRC/SSE materials, date-labelled product disclosures, and a live primary-source recheck showing the 2025 rule transition.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: No retained, date-by-date complete effective rule, fee, broker-access, and account-eligibility version package across a proposed test period.
gate_matrix.disposition: Historical context only; no rule-continuity certification.

gate_matrix.gate: continuous historical series and annual/rolling assessment length
gate_matrix.evidence: 1,250 retained official daily OHLCV rows span 2021-06-21 to 2026-08-14, allowing future annual-boundary and nominal five-year price-diagnostic design.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: No certified calendar completeness, historical available-at field, adjustment convention, corporate-action ledger, or executable fill data.
gate_matrix.disposition: No return calculation is admitted from this input alone.

gate_matrix.evidence: Nine retained distribution rows identify per-share cash and ex-right dates; the captured historical-NAV endpoint returned zero rows.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: Daily prices do not state adjustment treatment; distribution rows do not establish entitlement, cash receipt, tax, reinvestment, or investor accounting; an auditable NAV/total-return series is absent.
gate_matrix.disposition: Do not combine or substitute price, NAV, cash distribution, cash-flow distribution rate, or investor total return.

gate_matrix.evidence: Date-labelled fund disclosures contain fund-level fee information; current venue rules can be checked for venue-level arrangements.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: No dated investor-specific broker commission, tax, account, custody/transfer, cash-transfer, spread, slippage, rejected-order, or failed-fill cost ledger.
gate_matrix.disposition: No after-cost result or net-return test.

gate_matrix.evidence: The current REIT rule and the 2026 SSE trading rule establish a general rule chain for 100-unit competitive orders/whole multiples, odd-residual sales, and fund trading mechanics; official education materials and retained daily data further describe mechanism and volume.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: No historical bid/ask, depth, trade-by-trade fills, partial/no-fill, trading-status, suspension, or settlement ledger.
gate_matrix.disposition: Do not equate closing price or volume with executable liquidity.

gate_matrix.evidence: The current REIT rule describes generic public-investor participation via securities firms or off-exchange sales agents and risk-disclosure before an ordinary investor's first subscription or purchase.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: No dated broker-level permission, account type, risk-disclosure completion, suitability result, transfer-custody path, or settlement confirmation for any person.

gate_matrix.gate: point-in-time route universe and strategy governance
gate_matrix.evidence: Only one nonselective retained source probe is available to this audit.
gate_matrix.blocking_gap: No complete historic public-REIT universe with listing, termination, expansion, corporate action, availability, eligibility, prices, NAVs, distributions, and uniform costs; no predeclared selection/rebalance/exit rule.
gate_matrix.disposition: No product or route strategy may be selected or tested.

strict_test_boundary.five_percent_role: A hypothetical future research hurdle only; not a promised, forecast, stable, or minimum return.
strict_test_boundary.reason: The total-return/NAV/distribution, dated after-cost execution, eligibility, and point-in-time-universe fields required for a rigorous test are not all present.

required_before_any_future_test: A lawfully retainable, point-in-time public-REIT master universe with listing, termination, expansion, corporate-action, and trade-status history.
A dated and documented price/NAV/distribution/corporate-action ledger with adjustment basis, availability timestamps, cash-credit and tax/reinvestment treatment.
Dated fund-level and investor-level cost records, including broker, tax, account, transfer, spread, slippage, no-fill, partial-fill, and settlement treatment.
Dated, non-sensitive broker/venue records establishing the relevant eligibility and risk-disclosure path without inferring any person's suitability.
A predeclared non-product-selective universe rule, selection calendar, execution, valuation, suspension, and exit protocol, followed by independent reconstruction.

current_disposition.next_research_gate: Obtain and hash the missing point-in-time total-return, cost, execution, eligibility, and universe records before defining or calculating any strategy.
prohibitions: Do not select a public REIT product or infer that the retained probe is a candidate.
Do not calculate, state, forecast, or promise a return from this C20 readiness artifact.
Do not treat closing price, volume, NAV, cash distribution, or a fund-level fee as a personal executable net result.
Do not infer access, suitability, liquidity, or order fill for any person.
Do not open an account, complete risk disclosure, transfer custody, subscribe, redeem, buy, sell, place an order, contact a broker, or move cash.
